description: rgb_ycc_start scores 98.2% in re/tools/match.py: its one unequal instruction is `mov dword ptr [esp + 0x1c], 0x807fff` on both sides. path to resolution: match.py: for the exe, which has no relocations, mask an immediate as an address only when both sides hold an address, or compare equal immediates as equal. Then re-run the libjpeg wrappers.

description: Golfer flag dword +0x10 after S10.8. Bits 0x4 / 0x8 / 0x10 (a placed object of kind 0xa / 8 / 6 used, with a fee) and 0x10000 (rides) are named from our code (log/roadmap/S10/8_merge.md section 3). The other open bits of U-0009 keep no meaning. golf.pdb's defines (0x20 / 0x40 lean left / right, 0x8000 in cart, 0x20000 alt reaction, 0x80000 slow walk, 0x200000 story advanced, 0x400000 ball trail, 0x40000 ball moving, 0x10000000 exact aim) are leads only. Their 0x8000 `in cart` disagrees with the riding test at 0x0046b5fe, which reads 0x10000.
path to resolution: Read each bit's setter and tester against the lead, starting with 0x20 / 0x40 (prepareShot 0x00425c52 / 0x00425c7f, test 0x0042daee) and 0x40000 / 0x400000 (ball flight in updateGolfers).
